content: Idachen sa Phero ọttaar
Mada cho afa akk'akwọbha, Phero ọttaara idachen: k'idachen ọttaar da obe k'ọraanga kwa Nile ọkhaan-ọkhaan,
ore da abhaam azenamfa p'ajibhi for, abira ade bi dọrọdọrọ ayini k'ọraanga kwa Nile akwu achi araraari p'ameni m'ọraanga ọkhaan-ọkhaan.
Ayongi mẹ, abhaam azenamfa adọdọk p'akkokh-okkokhi abira apyibh ka for, ayin abaanga mbonggo p'ajibhi for p'awobh m'ọraanga kwa Nile ọkhaan-ọkhaan.
Abhaam mba p'akkokh-okkokhi abira apyibh ka for achi p'ajibhi ka for. Wa Phero ọphyọbha k'ọda.
Iwa Phero obiro ọtza oyima, ọn-ọttaara idachen idọdọk. Ore ẹbọkparin dani ch'etzim abhọra azenamfa p'abari ẹfa, abira ajibh-ojibh.
Ayongi mba, abọkpa-bhọra azenamfa adọdọk p'akkokh-okkokhi, p'ọphapha kw'ofon k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-eyin ogwum, abira ayin.
Mẹ wọ, abọkpa-bhọra mba azenamfa p'akkokh-okkokhi amyi azenamfa p'ajibhi for biphyir. Mada Phero ọkk'ọda ọphyọbha, mẹ kw'on-orong bi, idachen s'ọttaar.

Mada ewu en-ehobh, achibhi ayak Phero atzim, ofona mẹ, ọtzọhm anọng bi, bẹ ayeri anọng p'am-asi mbọhng biphyir, ọmaana atzim-nọnga-nọng kpenamkpen makhọra Ijip. Mada bẹ akwu apyiri, ọgbaak bẹ ọdachen f'ọttaar. Yina, ọnọng manda wani kw'ofha osi ẹjaakhi ch'ọdachen fa Phero kode.
Mẹ wọ, oho kw'anọng p'am-anang Phero atzuk, oben bi, “Mayina kaam nkk'ottotto kwaam njima.
Wa ọkhaam ogbe kwa Phero ọdọkhi ettem ttara atzọhmnọng pẹ, wa ọtzọhm kaam, ọmaana oho kw'anọng p'am-asi ọchattọhk mgbakkọhbh, k'ọhọhm kw'oho kw'akker-agbakkọkkọhbha.
Wa k'erungiwu dani, man anọng afa mọttaar ọdachen ngọmi-ngọmi, idachen kpenamkpen ikhaama ẹjaakhi chẹ.
Wa mọtzọkha ọdachen mva ọgbaak oHiburu-dikkobh wani kw'ode ọtzọhmnọng kw'oho kw'akker-agbakkọkkọhbha. Wa mọgbaakh-ẹ ọdachen faman, kẹ obiro osi ẹjaakhi ch'ọdachen mva ọnang man.
Wa idik nnuma iyini itzor mach'osi ẹjaakhi. Kaam wa bẹ ọkpa nnam ọnang-m ewobha chaam, yina, wa bẹ arena oyok k'edik.”

Iwa Phero ọtzọhm anọng bi, bẹ atzima Josẹph akwu. Mẹ ẹba mẹ, bẹ atza arọbh-ẹ k'ọgbakkọhbh-họhm atzima akwu. Mada Josẹph okk'agbaphyubha pẹ ophyiri, obiro obhona ọbara f'ọfọr ka for, ofona ọtza okhebha Phero.
Phero oben Josẹph bi, “Kaam nttaar idachen, s'ọnọng manda wani oni ẹjaakhi ọfha ọnang. Yina, kaam nkk'mmaanga bi, kọ am-asi ẹjaakhi ch'ọdachen anang anọng.”
Josẹph obhina Phero bi, “Kaam ẹfa kingaam bi, mminsi ẹjaakhi ch'ọdachen nnang anọng e. Yina, Ibinọkpaabyi wọ ọ́nang ebhina ẹkkakka e.”
Phero ọgbaak Josẹph bi, “Kaam nttaar idachen da mbe k'ọraanga kwa Nile ọkhaan-ọkhaan.
Nne da abhaam azenamfa p'ajibhi for ayini k'ọraanga kwa Nile, akwu achi araraari m'ọraanga ọkhaan-ọkhaan.
Ogbe k'obhiri, abhaam azenamfa adọdọk p'akkokh-okkokhi abira aphyibh ka for, ayin m'ọraanga. Kaam mada ogbe odede e, abhaam p'akkokhi ka for mando ndimi mminna m'irek nna s'Ijip.
Abhaam mba p'akkokh-okkokhi, abira aphyibh ka for an-achi p'ajibhi ka for p'ira achi eden ayin.
Chibhi da bẹ akk'ayok acha biphyir, bẹ atzima akkeri ka for macha bẹ adede. Mando kwa mgbe mphyọbha k'ọda.
“K'idachen ọdọdọk, kaam nne da abọkpa-bhọra azenamfa p'ajibhi for ameni k'erin dani.
Ayongi mbuma, abọkpa-bhọra azenamfa adọdọk p'akkokh-okkokhi abira amen k'ebọkparin dani, ọphapha kw'iyoma kw'ofon kẹ da ewuchen em-eyin ogwuma bẹ.
Mẹ wọ, abọkpa-bhọra mba azenamfa p'akkokh-okkokhi amyi azenamfa p'ajibhi for biphyir. Kaam ndọkha idik nna biphyir mgbaak anọng p'am-asi mbọhng biphyir, yina, ọnọng kw'ọfha osi ẹjaakhi ọnang-m kode.”
Mẹ wọ, Josẹph ọgbaak Phero bi, “Ọdachen mva ode odem wani, fẹ obiro ọkhaama ẹjaakhi dani. Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ẹjaakhi ọsa ọnang Phero k'odik kw'ọkhami bi osi.
Ọdachen mva ọkhaam ẹjaakhi dani, ch'ede bi: Abhaam mbuma azenamfa p'ajibhi for, abe anang cho azenamfa. Abọkpa-bhọra mbuma azenamfa p'ajibhi for, abira abe anang cho azenamfa.
Abhaam mbuma azenamfa p'akkokh-okkokhi p'akpong-nnam ayin, ọmaana abọkpa-bhọra mbuma azenamfa p'ani for ajibhi, p'ọphapha kw'ofon k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-eyin, abe anang cho azenamfa p'okwo f'ideden.
“Itta, ode macha mgbaakh-ọ bi, Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ẹjaakhi ọsa ọnang Phero k'odik kw'ọkhami bi, osi.
Ka cho azenamfa k'itzitzikha, irek s'Ijip ikhaama ọchattọhk k'ọhaabh.
Yina, cho azenamfa p'okwo f'ideden án-atzor cho p'ọhaabh nnam. Mẹ wọ, anọng áraama ọhaabh f'Ijip ọraama, okwo f'ideden obiro ọ́nyaami ochi irek nna.
“Anọng ogbe kw'ọhaabh f'irek nna dọk ájima, okhuri da okwo mva f'ideden ọ́n-ọgaangi oyong-oyongi.
Wa Phero ọttaar idachen nna rani k'adem afa, okhuri da iwa Ibinọkpaabyi okk'ochibhi ọtzam ọsa. Ogbe kobhir, Ibinọkpaabyi osi kwẹ osi.
“Mẹ wọ, tte Phero oror ojinọng wani kw'ọkhaam etzina, ọmaana ekkoji, ifha ọnang ojinọng nwa ẹfa ch'otzima okkeri irek s'Ijip.
Tte Phero otzekha atzọhmnọng p'akkeri irek nna bi, bẹ atzọkha ọchattọhk k'Ijip, okhung wani k'akhung azen ahok, ka cho azenamfa mba p'ọhaabh.
Tte ofona k'ẹfa cha Phero bi, ka cho azenamfa mba p'ọhaabh p'akwu, anọng mba atzọkha ọchattọhk ahok k'idedenmon.
Bẹ aye ọchattọhk mva anang anọng p'ẹkhọma nda, ifha bẹ atzima fẹ ka cho azenamfa mba p'okwo f'ideden okwu k'Ijip, ifha okwo mva f'ideden oningi ẹkhọma nda odimi.”
Iwa Phero ọmaana akhaan-nọng pẹ biphyir are bi, kwẹ okk'ojibha.
Mẹ wọ, Phero ọbọbh atzọhmnọng pẹ bi, “Na mofha ore ọnọng kw'ode mach'ojinọng nwa, kw'ọkhaam ekkoji ch'efon k'Ibinọkpaabyi o?”
Mẹ wọ, Phero oben Josẹph bi, “Mada Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ọ ẹjaakhi ch'idik nna biphyir ọnanga, ọnọng ọdọdọk kw'ọkhaam etzina ọmaana ekkoji cha kọ akhaam kode.
Kọ án-ade oho k'ọvaar-dimpa kwaam, anọng paam biphyir an-ahakha eho anang ndọhna sọ. Orenga k'ikpokpobha s'ẹvaar sẹ-sẹ s'akhaam ńna ndima mbar nyọhng-ọ.”
Josẹph otzim ededen k'Ijip
Iwa Phero oben Josẹph bi, “Kaam nkk'ọ ọbọhk k'eho nnana bi, adabh irek s'Ijip makhọra.”
Mando kwa Phero ọwọr ẹbaanga chẹ ch'ẹnọhna, okhe Josẹph. Ọtzọkha ẹnya cha bẹ atzim ndik-nyokhasẹ ọkkakka asi, ọfọr-ẹ, yina ọn-ọtzọk ogimma kwa gol ọkhẹ-ẹ k'ẹdọhngi.

Ọtzọkh-ẹ ọnana k'ọkpaar kwa nnyanyaang mmindọr, bẹ ayaar-ẹ mach'ojukwa kwẹ, anọng arenga k'itzitzikha am-awuri amọng aben bi, “Bọng kebh-ẹ eden!” Mẹ wọ, Phero ọnang Josẹph ẹfa ch'ọdabh irek s'Ijip biphyir.
Phero obiro oben Josẹph bi, “Kaam Phero wọ nde ọvaarnọng, yina, ẹfa eni ka kọ efon, ọnọng kw'ọ́khaama ẹfa ch'oyebh ọbọhk kwẹ obiro ode obho kwẹ o, makhọra irek s'Ijip kode.”
Phero on-okpe Josẹph, Zaphenat-Panea. Obiro ọtzọkha ominanwa kw'okpen Asenat kw'ode nnwa kwa Potiphera, ọnang-ẹ k'ọbada. Wa Potiphera ode ọfọhnẹja kwa On. Wa Josẹph orenga ọkhọri irek s'Ijip bi waam.

Mando kwa Josẹph obin k'itzitzikha sa Phero, orenga ọkpaanga irek s'Ijip biphyir. Wa Josẹph ode ojinọng kw'ode cho ẹrọbh obhiri jobh, k'ogbe kw'ọttẹwọr osi ọtzọhm ọmaana Phero, kw'ode ọvaarnọng kw'Ijip.
Ma cho mba azenamfa p'ọhaabh, wa irerek ihak for ijibh ekpo.
Josẹph ọtzọkha ọchattọhk k'Ijip biphyir, ma cho mba azenamfa p'ọhaabh, ohok k'ideden-mon. K'odedenmon kpenamkpen, wa ohokhi ọchattọhk-dem fa bẹ ayaabh m'obhon nwuma.
Mando kwa Josẹph oye ẹchakpo mach'abọkpa k'ọhaabh mach'oyeyeng kw'ọraanga kw'ideden. Wa ọchattọhk mva ọhaabhi maa, ọkwọbha obhik ohohok, da bẹ ani dọk afha abhik.
Yina ogbe kw'okwo mva f'ideden opyiri, wa Asenat kw'ode ominanwa kwa Potiphera kw'ode ọfọhnẹja kwa On, okk'va afa p'ijinọng ọmaana ọnang Josẹph.
Josẹph okpe ocheden-nwa kwẹ, Manasẹ, oben bi, “Ofon da Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ọsa bi, kaam nnaama ihem saam biphyir, ọmaana efonamma ch'otte kwaam biphyir.”
Okpe nnwa kw'ottong afa Ephraim, oben bi, “Ofon da Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'aam ọsa bi, ngaama va m'irek nna s'ihem saam.”
Mada cho azenamfa mba p'ọhaabh k'irek s'Ijip akk'akwa akwọbha,
cho mbonggo azenamfa p'okwo f'ideden attẹwọr, mach'iwa Josẹph ọkk'ẹjaakhi ọtzam ọsa. Wa okwo f'ideden owobh makhọra idibhon biphyir. Yina, wa ọchattọhk owobh k'ọhaabh makhọra Ijip.

K'ogbe kw'okwo ọn-ọttẹwọr ọkhaama anọng p'Ijip, bẹ atza abhom amọng p'ọchattọhk akpẹkhi Phero. Ofona mẹ, Phero oben anọng p'Ijip biphyir bi, “Bọng nọhng ka Josẹph, bọng asi odik kpenamkpen kw'oben bi, bọng asi.”
K'ogbe kw'okwo mva f'ideden ọkk'ọn-ọnyaami k'ẹkhọma nda biphyir, Josẹph okwunga ihọhm s'iwa bẹ aye ọchattọhk, okpe ọchattọhk anang anọng p'Ijip, okhuri bi, wa okwo f'ideden owobh k'Ijip makhọra.
Wa anọng abina k'idibhon biphyir atza adebh ọchattọhk ka mbọhk sa Josẹph k'Ijip, okhuri bi, wa okwo f'ideden ọgaang-ọgaangi makhọra.
